wikidot5e:spell:abi-dalzims-horrid-wilti.effectSummary: A 30-foot cube within range forces each creature in it to make a Constitution save. Constructs and undead are unaffected; plants and water elementals save with disadvantage. A failed save deals 12d8 necrotic damage, or half on a success. Nonmagical plants in the area that are not creatures wither and die instantly.

wikidot5e:spell:absorb-elements.effectSummary: You gain resistance to the triggering acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage type until the start of your next turn. The first melee attack you hit with on your next turn deals an extra 1d6 damage of that type, then the spell ends. Using a slot above 1st increases the extra damage by 1d6 per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:acid-splash.effectSummary: Choose one creature in range, or two creatures in range that are within 5 feet of each other. Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 acid damage on a failure. The damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.

wikidot5e:spell:acid-stream.effectSummary: Creatures in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line make a Dexterity save. On a failure, a creature is coated in acid for the spell's duration and takes 3d4 acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use an action to scrape or wash the acid from itself or another creature, ending that coating. Slots above 1st add 1d4 damage per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:aganazzars-scorcher.effectSummary: A 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of flame extends from you. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. A slot above 2nd adds 1d8 damage per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:aid.effectSummary: Choose up to three creatures within range. For the duration, each target's hit point maximum and current hit points both increase by 5. A slot above 2nd increases both amounts by an additional 5 per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:air-bubble.effectSummary: A willing creature in range gains a spectral globe of fresh air around one head for the duration; one globe is sufficient for a multiheaded creature if its heads share a respiratory system. A slot above 2nd creates two additional globes per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:alarm.effectSummary: Ward a door, window, or area no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, a Tiny or larger creature touching or entering the ward triggers the alarm unless you designated it as exempt when casting. Choose a mental or audible alarm: the mental ping reaches you within 1 mile and wakes you if asleep; the audible alarm sounds like a hand bell for 10 seconds and can be heard within 60 feet.

wikidot5e:spell:alter-self.effectSummary: Choose one form option when casting and, while the spell lasts, you can use an action to switch options. Aquatic Adaptation lets you breathe underwater and gives you a swim speed equal to your walking speed. Change Appearance lets you alter your visible features and voice repeatedly, but not your statistics, size, or basic body plan. Natural Weapons gives you a chosen natural unarmed weapon that deals 1d6 appropriate bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage; you are proficient with it, it counts as magical, and it grants +1 to its attack and damage rolls.

wikidot5e:spell:animal-friendship.effectSummary: Choose a beast in range that can see and hear you. If its Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails; otherwise it makes a Wisdom save and is charmed by you for the duration on a failure. The charm ends if you or one of your companions harms it. A slot above 1st lets you affect one additional beast per slot level.
